source: CODEC project bunker tests (INSEMEX Petrosani, 2016-2017) on two beam-column specimens, as reported in: FRAMEBLAST technical report, stage I, 2017 (Politehnica University Timisoara, frameblast_files/Raport_etapa_1_2017_05122017_rev.pdf, pp. 6-7); B. Ahmed, Damage characterization in building structures due to blast actions, SUSCOS master's thesis, CTU Prague, 2018 (hdl:10467/78301), section 4.2 and Table 5; F. Dinu, I. Marginean, D. Dubina, A. Khalil and E. De Iuliis, ASCCS 2018, doi:10.4995/ASCCS2018.2018.7186. The test paper itself, Dinu, Marginean, Dubina, Kovacs and Ghicioi, Procedia Engineering 210 (2017) 377-385, doi:10.1016/j.proeng.2017.11.091, was not obtained.

specimen.column: HEB260, flanges cut to 160 mm wide, weak axis in the frame's plane
specimen.beams: two half-span IPE beams on extended end plates (M24 10.9), one transverse half-span beam on cleats; tubular lateral restraints at the beams' ends
specimen.lengthNote: column length and end conditions not given in the sources obtained

shots.name: m3
shots.note: elastic; S6 swung about +/-2,500 microstrain over 3 ms (report Fig. 8b, read off)

shots.name: m4
shots.chargeNote: the report gives only the 0.5 m; 1.815 kg at 0.5 m is the ASCCS paper's 'little plastic deformations'

shots.name: m5
shots.outcome: web removed over almost twice the flange width; flanges bowed and held (no axial load); gauges destroyed

gauges: S1-S8 in pairs on the web, 100 mm then 200 mm apart down from the beams' level (report Fig. 8a); which face and their height relative to the charge are not given

fullScaleBuilding.source: FRAMEBLAST technical report, stage II, 2018, pp. 7-10: a 2 x 2 bay, two-storey frame of HEB260 columns at Petrosani, floors loaded to 10 kN/m2 by water tanks, charges 1.8 m above ground (1.5 m above the foundation) near the central ground-floor column, cumulative on the same column

shots.name: E3
shots.outcome: first permanent deformation: web at the charge and the flanges

shots.name: E5
shots.outcome: web dished; the flanges act partly as a reflector

shots.name: E8
shots.outcome: column removed; adjacent beams left with permanent deflection
